entries.requirement: Any web surface content that advances on its own (carousel, device demo, rotating proof) ships a visible, keyboard-operable pause control, stops when hidden or out of view, and under prefers-reduced-motion does not autoplay while keeping every state reachable by a non-motion control.
entries.why: Auto-advancing content without pause fails WCAG 2.2.2, and CDIO-07 sec.5 makes the reduced-motion floor non-arbitrable. The reference that seeded VP-016 itself had no pause control.
